messages.content: Find me a documentary about global warming.

function.name: retrieve_scientific_paper
function.description: Fetches the details of scientific research paper based on its topic. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

year.description: Year of publishing of the research paper. If not specified, fetches the most recent paper

author.description: Author of the research paper. If not specified, fetches the paper with most citations

message.content:
Here are a few highly regarded documentaries that explore global warming and climate change:

| Title | Year | Synopsis | Where to Watch |
|-------|------|----------|----------------|
| **An Inconvenient Truth** | 2006 | Former Vice‑President Al Gore presents scientific evidence on climate change, its impacts, and solutions. | Amazon Prime Video, iTunes, Google Play |
| **An Inconvenient Sequel: Truth to Power** | 2017 | A follow‑up that examines progress (or lack thereof) since the first film, featuring new data and interviews with scientists and activists. | Amazon Prime Video, iTunes, Google Play |
| **Before the Flood** | 2016 | Leonardo DiCaprio travels the world to witness climate impacts firsthand, interviewing experts and policymakers. | Netflix, Amazon Prime Video, iTunes |
| **The 11th Hour** | 2007 | Produced by Leonardo DiCaprio, this film features voices from scientists, environmentalists, and business leaders discussing solutions to the climate crisis. | Amazon Prime Video, iTunes |
| **Our Planet** (Series) | 2019 | While not solely about climate change, this nature series highlights how warming threatens ecosystems worldwide. | Netflix |
| **Climate Change: The Facts** | 2020 | A short, fact‑based documentary that explains the science behind global warming and its consequences. | YouTube (official channel), Vimeo |

If you’re looking for something more recent or region‑specific, let me know and I can help narrow it down!
